# Fixture Mod

A mod for **Europa Universalis IV** that adds *missions*, ~~bugs~~ and
[links](https://example.com/path?a=1&b=2). Text with [brackets] stays text.

![Banner](https://example.com/banner.png)

## Features

- Missions for:
  1. Sweden
  2. Denmark
- Events with `inline code`
